name: Khipu (Quipu)
notes: Andean knotted-string recording devices (Inka and predecessor cultures). Whether khipu constitute writing at all — as opposed to a purely numerical/mnemonic accounting device — is itself a live, unresolved dispute, not merely an origin-type question; see claim_khipu_writing_status_disputed. Confidently read as numerical/accounting records; narrative/linguistic content (argued for by Urton 2003 and subsequent statistical work) remains unconfirmed by any accepted decipherment.
